title: Collateral Protection Insurance Compliance Standard — Lapses and Insurance Notices to Borrowers
content:
**Establishing a lapse.** Under Collateral Protection Insurance a lapse is established only by one of the product's lapse sources: an insurer cancellation notice, an insurer non-renewal notice, a policy expiration with no renewal proof, or no acceptable proof within the product's initial proof period after funding. The lapse date is the first day without acceptable coverage.

**First lapse notice.** The first lapse notice is mailed within the product's first-notice period after the lapse is detected.

**Second lapse notice.** A second lapse notice may be mailed only when its mailing date is at least the product's second-notice interval after the first lapse notice was mailed. That interval is counted in calendar days from the mailing date of the first lapse notice, and a mailing exactly on the boundary qualifies.

**Delivery and content.** Notices go by the product's delivery method to the mailing address on file, with an email copy when the product sends email copies and an email is on file. Each lapse notice states the plan's monthly premium and deductible, that placed coverage protects only the company, and how to send proof.

**Which record may receive which notice.** Lapse notices are mailed only on a record in lapse notice status, placement notices only on a force-placed record, and deficient-proof and cancellation notices on any record that is not closed.

## Second-notice spacing on the boundary

With the first lapse notice mailed on a hypothetical day 0 and an interval of N calendar days:

| Second-notice mailing day | May it be mailed? |
|---|---|
| day N minus 1 | no — earlier than the interval |
| day N | yes — exactly on the boundary qualifies |
| day N plus 1 | yes |

The day count starts from the first lapse notice's own mailing date, as the system records it, and not from the lapse date or the date the lapse was detected.

## Notices by record status

| Record status | Lapse notices | Placement notice | Deficient-proof notice | Cancellation notice |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pending verification | no | no | yes | yes |
| Compliant | no | no | yes | yes |
| Lapse notice | yes | no | yes | yes |
| Force-placed | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Closed | no | no | no | no |
